cases.explain: «голые вершины» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “Lift up your eyes to the bare heights, and see! Where have you not been lain with? You have sat waiting for them by the road, as an Arabian in the wilderness. You have polluted the land with your prostitution and with your wickedness.

cases.sentence: Несмотря на все это, Иудея, ___ Израиля, вернулась ко Мне не от всего сердца, а лишь притворяясь, — возвещает Господь.
cases.explain: «вероломная сестра» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Yet for all this her treacherous sister, Judah, has not returned to me with her whole heart, but only in pretense,” says Yahweh.

cases.sentence: — Вернись, ___, — возвещает Господь, — потому что Я твой супруг.
cases.explain: «неверный народ» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Return, backsliding children,” says Yahweh; “for I am a husband to you. I will take one of you from a city, and two from a family, and I will bring you to Zion.

cases.sentence: В те дни, когда вы сильно умножитесь числом в стране, — возвещает Господь, — уже не будут больше говорить: «Ковчег ___» .
cases.explain: «Господнего завета» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: It will come to pass, when you are multiplied and increased in the land, in those days,” says Yahweh, “they will no longer say, ‘the ark of Yahweh’s covenant!’ It will not come to mind. They won’t remember it. They won’t miss it, nor will another be made.

cases.sentence: Не будут о нем больше думать, не будут его вспоминать; не будут больше тосковать о нем и ___ не сделают.
cases.explain: «другого ковчега» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: It will come to pass, when you are multiplied and increased in the land, in those days,” says Yahweh, “they will no longer say, ‘the ark of Yahweh’s covenant!’ It will not come to mind. They won’t remember it. They won’t miss it, nor will another be made.

cases.sentence: В то время назовут Иерусалим ___, и все народы соберутся в Иерусалиме, чтобы почтить Имя Господа.
cases.explain: «Господним престолом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: At that time they will call Jerusalem ‘Yahweh’s Throne;’ and all the nations will be gathered to it, to Yahweh’s name, to Jerusalem. They will no longer walk after the stubbornness of their evil heart.

cases.sentence: Они больше не будут поступать по упрямству своих ___.
cases.explain: «злых сердец» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: At that time they will call Jerusalem ‘Yahweh’s Throne;’ and all the nations will be gathered to it, to Yahweh’s name, to Jerusalem. They will no longer walk after the stubbornness of their evil heart.

cases.sentence: В те дни дом Иуды соберется с домом Израиля, и вместе они уйдут из ___ в ту землю, которую Я дал их отцам.
cases.explain: «северных земель» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and they will come together out of the land of the north to the land that I gave for an inheritance to your fathers.

cases.explain: «голых вершинах» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: A voice is heard on the bare heights, the weeping and the petitions of the children of Israel; because they have perverted their way, they have forgotten Yahweh their God.

cases.explain: «неверный народ» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Return, you backsliding children, and I will heal your backsliding. “Behold, we have come to you; for you are Yahweh our God.
